title: RubyLLM: A Ruby framework for all major AI providers
summary: RubyLLM is a Ruby framework that provides a unified, developer-friendly interface for interacting with all major AI/LLM providers including OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and others, allowing Ruby developers to easily switch between providers without learning different APIs.
problem_solved: Eliminates the need for Ruby developers to write separate integrations for each AI provider by offering a consistent, Ruby-idiomatic API across all major LLM services.
why_valuable: It democratizes AI access for the Ruby ecosystem, enabling Rails and Ruby developers to integrate multiple LLM providers with minimal boilerplate code and clean syntax.
